background: Five-time champion as a player (Bulls, Spurs), Phoenix Suns GM (2007-10) and TNT analyst before taking the Warriors job in May 2014 with no prior coaching experience. Won titles in 2015, 2017, 2018 and 2022, set the 73-9 record in 2015-16 (Coach of the Year) and built a motion/split-cut offense that reshaped the league. Coached Team USA to Olympic gold in Paris 2024. Career regular-season record 604-353 through 2025-26 (567-308 through 2024-25 per StatMuse), playoffs 104-48. The post-2022 Warriors have been a play-in-level team: 2023-24 and 2025-26 play-in exits, 2024-25 second-round exit after Curry's hamstring injury. Signed a two-year extension in May 2026 running through 2027-28; he has said the 2026-27 roster is not a title contender but should be competitive.

Challenge record was league-worst in 2023-24; frequent officiating rants after close losses
key_strengths: Architect of the league's premier motion/split-cut offense; elite ball movement and spacing concepts
Four championships and strong historical in-series adjustment record; culture and player buy-in
Protects stars' health with disciplined minute management over an 82-game season
Versatile switch-based defense built around Green when communication is sharp
